**New Features / Improvements:**
* Added initial cross-platform system tray/menu bar application variant.
* Added caching step to universal macOS publish job.
* Added single instance enforcement across executable variants.
* Added key command to console app for editing the `proxiedhosts.txt` file.
* Updated release workflow to include tray project.
* Updated caching keys to include the `Directory.Build.props` file.
* Changed location of common project settings to the `Directory.Build.props` file.
* Removed packaged `proxiedhosts.txt` as it can be generated on first run.
* Updated proxy configuration to centralize path info and made it a singleton.
